verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a plugin API and a local HTTP API server that dispatches methods through a single POST /api endpoint. The evidence, however, explicitly notes that no versioning policy is published, and nothing in the pack mentions API versions or a deprecation policy. The plugin API documentation is also described as community-driven rather than an official versioned contract.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
